remarks: LIVE THE PERPETUAL VACATION LIFE IN NOROTON BAY - Experience this chic, sun-drenched Beach Colonial, perfectly situated on an open double lot. Extensively remodeled, the home's bright, open configuration is designed for effortless year-round family living and entertaining. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with expansive terraces, professionally landscaped grounds, and a charming signature front porch. Retreat to the primary suite or the home office to enjoy serene water views. As part of "The Bay" community, you are steps away from a private beach, pier, and a private yacht club. Association amenities include boat moorings, a seasonal snack bar, and a vibrant year-round social calendar. All of this with Darien's award winning schools and an easy commute to NYC. A true gem on Fairfield County's Gold Coast - this is a MUST-SEE!!!
